data.title: 1. The invoice, its lines and its receivables (parallel)

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(s.id AS CHAR), 'so_id', s.so_id, 'gd_id', s.gd_id, 'si_status', s.si_status,
       'sales_invoice_no', s.sales_invoice_no) AS j
  FROM sales_invoice s
 WHERE s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_sic_start.data.tenantId}}' AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.id = {{node:code_sic_start.data.idSql}}

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('doc', CAST(l.sales_invoice_id AS CHAR), 'id', CAST(l.id AS CHAR), 'parent_id', CAST(l.parent_id AS CHAR),
       'line_so_id', l.line_so_id, 'so_line_id', CAST(l.so_line_id AS CHAR), 'line_gd_id', CAST(l.line_gd_id AS CHAR),
       'gd_line_id', CAST(l.gd_line_id AS CHAR), 'invoice_qty', l.invoice_qty) AS j
  FROM sales_invoice_zt0c3x55_sub l
 WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_sic_start.data.tenantId}}' AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.sales_invoice_id = {{node:code_sic_start.data.idSql}}
 ORDER BY l.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(a.id AS CHAR), 'ar_invoice_no', a.ar_invoice_no) AS j
  FROM ar_invoice a
 WHERE a.tenant_id = '{{node:code_sic_start.data.tenantId}}' AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.si_id = {{node:code_sic_start.data.idSql}}
 ORDER BY a.id

data.name: 3. Sales order lines (what the reversal reads)

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('doc', CAST(s.id AS CHAR), 'id', CAST(l.id AS CHAR), 'parent_id', CAST(l.parent_id AS CHAR),
       'so_quantity', l.so_quantity, 'invoice_qty', l.invoice_qty, 'posted_qty', l.posted_qty, 'si_status', l.si_status) AS j
  FROM sales_order s
  LEFT JOIN sales_order_axszx8cj_sub l ON l.sales_order_id = s.id AND l.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_sic_start.data.tenantId}}' AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.id IN ({{node:code_sic_ids.data.soIdsSql}})
 ORDER BY s.id, l.id

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('doc', CAST(g.id AS CHAR), 'id', CAST(l.id AS CHAR), 'parent_id', CAST(l.parent_id AS CHAR),
       'gd_qty', l.gd_qty, 'invoice_qty', l.invoice_qty, 'si_status', l.si_status) AS j
  FROM goods_delivery g
  LEFT JOIN goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub l ON l.goods_delivery_id = g.id AND l.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_sic_start.data.tenantId}}' AND g.is_deleted = 0 AND g.id IN ({{node:code_sic_ids.data.gdIdsSql}})
 ORDER BY g.id, l.id
